name: Split
late_run_function: Multiplies every on-hit effect
deliberate_weakness: Bullets fan into a spread: strong close and weaker at range; armor shrugs off weak bullets

name: Grow
early_run_function: Bigger and harder-hitting bullets but slower to charge
late_run_function: Answer to armor; carries single-bullet builds
deliberate_weakness: Charge time cuts fire rate

name: Poison
early_run_function: Steady damage on anything you tag
late_run_function: Ticks on every Split bullet; feeds Exploit
deliberate_weakness: -20% direct damage for the ticks; regenerators out-heal slow stacks

name: Pierce
late_run_function: Each pierce re-triggers on-hit effects
deliberate_weakness: Loses 20% damage per enemy passed; little use against lone bosses

name: Quickdraw
late_run_function: Feeds every-Nth triggers quickly
deliberate_weakness: Drains the magazine faster

name: Exploit
late_run_function: Multiplies damage on debuffed enemies
deliberate_weakness: Big bonus needs a state source

name: Shrapnel
late_run_function: Every Split bullet explodes: swarm shredder
deliberate_weakness: Splash is weak vs armor

name: Chill
late_run_function: Keeps debuff active for Exploit
deliberate_weakness: Little value without a payoff

name: Bloodshot
late_run_function: Huge bullet count at high HP
deliberate_weakness: Shrinks as you take damage

name: Reclaimer
late_run_function: Near-infinite magazine at high fire rate
deliberate_weakness: Needs high bullet count to matter. Replaces Field Medic (heal removed)

name: Blast Ring
late_run_function: Constant area control
deliberate_weakness: Hurts you 8 HP each proc

name: Shockwave
late_run_function: Near-permanent crowd control
deliberate_weakness: Rarely triggers at slow fire rate

name: Echo
pillars_supported: Synergy;Counterplay;Run arc;Alien and unusual;Power fantasy;Felt immediately;Draft tension
late_run_function: Self-feeding bullet loop
deliberate_weakness: Spawned bullets limited to generation 2; hard to balance

name: Zigzag
early_run_function: Bullets weave and cross the same enemy twice
late_run_function: On-hit effects trigger twice per enemy
deliberate_weakness: Less precise aim; nothing alone

name: Ricochet
late_run_function: Extra hits multiply on-hit effects
deliberate_weakness: Each bounce loses 15% damage; bounce paths are hard to predict

name: Volatile Core
early_run_function: Kills pop a small fixed blast
late_run_function: Chain-kill explosions in swarms
deliberate_weakness: Fixed blast size to limit cost; explosion cap

name: Soul Snatcher
late_run_function: +0.1% damage per kill; huge by level 8
deliberate_weakness: Weak in boss fights; strong in swarms

name: Reaper
